sanskrit_verse:
नापृष्टैरनियुक्तैर्वा समं सत्यं प्रयत्नतः ।
वक्तव्यं साक्षिभि: साक्ष्यं विवादस्थानमागतै: ॥
transliteration: nāpṛṣṭair aniyuktair vā samaṃ satyaṃ prayatnataḥ / vaktavyaṃ sākṣibhiḥ sākṣyaṃ vivādasthānam āgataiḥ
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who have not been questioned or appointed must not speak the truth equally; witnesses arrived at the place of dispute must speak their testimony with effort.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derived from invocation and relevance, not mere presence
Causation through conscious engagement in the field of dispute
Capacity-based responsibility determined by direct involvement
Restoration logic requiring truthful alignment with dharma-vyavahara
Consciousness alignment via intentional participation in nyaya
executable_legal_axioms: IF witness is uninvoked AND has no causal relation to dispute THEN testimony is inadmissible
IF witness arrives at vivāda-sthāna THEN capacity for truthful speech is activated
IF testimony is offered without effort THEN it lacks juridical validity
IF a being speaks truthfully under dharma-awareness THEN restoration of harmony is enacted
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, only those whose testimony arises from direct causal connection or formal summons are permitted to testify. Truth-speaking must be an act of willful alignment with Dharma, not passive observation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through conscious effort and contextual relevance. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures that testimony manifests sequentially based on lawful summoning. Responsibility lies in alignment with satya, not fear of consequence. Retribution has no role—truth serves integration alone.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Unsummoned speakers undergo guided reintegration until readiness for truthful engagement emerges
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Witnesses affirm their causal link to the case before offering testimony
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: If testimony falters due to fear or confusion, realign through pramāṇa-based inquiry
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Post-testimony, witnesses engage in śuddhi practices to restore energetic neutrality
final_declaration: By the Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of All Dharma, this law stands executed. Justice flows as restoration. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
